component.name: 主机基础准备示例
component.description: 仅管理隔离示例目录；共享路径通过公开参数提供，回退拒绝删除已有、被替换或非空目录。

release.releaseNotes: 导入后为草稿；使用新建隔离目录完成安装与回退验证后才可发布。

parameters.name: shared_root
parameters.description: 本样板准备的共享根目录，仅限 /tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example- 前缀。实际业务路径应另建组件并验证。

actions.name: 回收本次创建的空目录

playbooks.content:
- name: Validate and manage only the declared isolated directory
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - python3
    - -c
    - "import json, os, stat, sys
from pathlib import Path
path, marker, metadata\
      \ = sys.argv[1:4]
metadata = json.loads(metadata)
if not path.startswith('/tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example-')\
      \ or Path(path).parent != Path('/tmp') or not Path(path).name[len('clusterforge-foundation-example-'):].replace('-',\
      \ '').replace('_','').isalnum():
    raise SystemExit('target must be one isolated\
      \ example directory directly under /tmp')
def inspect():
    try:
      \
      \  s = os.lstat(path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
\
      \    if not stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) or stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode):
        raise\
      \ SystemExit('target is not a real directory')
    return s
def baseline():
\
      \    data = json.loads(Path(marker).read_text())
    if data['metadata'] !=\
      \ metadata or data['path'] != path:
        raise SystemExit('recovery identity\
      \ does not match this operation')
    return data
current = inspect()
if\
      \ not Path(marker).exists():
    Path(marker).parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True,\
      \ exist_ok=True)
    data = {'metadata':metadata,'path':path,'existed':current\
      \ is not None, 'identity':[current.st_dev,current.st_ino] if current else None}
\
      \    with open(marker, 'x') as output:
        json.dump(data,output)
   \
      \ os.chmod(marker,0o600)
data = baseline()
if current is None:
    if data['existed']\
      \ or data['identity'] is not None:
        raise SystemExit('retained directory\
      \ disappeared; stop and investigate')
    os.mkdir(path,0o700)
    current\
      \ = inspect()
    data['identity']=[current.st_dev,current.st_ino]
    temporary=marker+'.tmp'
\
      \    with open(temporary,'w') as output:
        json.dump(data,output)
 \
      \   os.chmod(temporary,0o600)
    os.replace(temporary,marker)
if data['identity']\
      \ != [current.st_dev,current.st_ino]:
    raise SystemExit('directory identity\
      \ changed or creation receipt is missing')
"
    - '{{ cf.inputs.shared_root }}'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata | to_json }}'

"

component.name: 共享目录消费示例
component.description: 精确依赖主机基础准备，检查本机目录并建立消费标记。先回退消费者，再回退基础目录。

release.releaseNotes: 导入后为草稿；使用新建隔离目录完成安装与回退验证后才可发布。

parameters.name: prepared_root
parameters.description: 映射上游公开的 shared_root；安装前须在本机检查，不把参数映射当作主机就绪证据。

dependencies.purpose: 必须先在相同目标主机准备目录；消费期间以标记保留目录

actions.name: 回收本次创建的空目录

playbooks.content:
- name: Check mapped directory on this actual host
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}'
    follow: false
  register: cf_local_root
- name: Require prepared directory
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - cf_local_root.stat.isdir | default(false)
    - not (cf_local_root.stat.islnk | default(false))
- name: Hold explicit consumer marker
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - python3
    - -c
    - "import json, os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\npath, identity, mode = sys.argv[1:4]\n\
      if not str(Path(path).parent).startswith('/tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example-'):\n\
      \    raise SystemExit('unexpected root')\nif mode == 'install':\n    with open(path,\
      \ 'x') as out: out.write(identity)\nelse:\n    if Path(path).is_symlink() or\
      \ json.loads(Path(path).read_text()) != json.loads(identity):\n        raise\
      \ SystemExit('consumer marker identity differs')\n    if mode == 'rollback':\
      \ os.unlink(path)\n"
    - '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata | to_json }}'
    - install

- name: Check mapped directory on this actual host
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}'
    follow: false
  register: cf_local_root
- name: Require prepared directory
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - cf_local_root.stat.isdir | default(false)
    - not (cf_local_root.stat.islnk | default(false))
- name: Inspect consumer marker
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    follow: false
  register: cf_local_marker
- name: Require absent marker
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: not cf_local_marker.stat.exists

- name: Check mapped directory on this actual host
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}'
    follow: false
  register: cf_local_root
- name: Require prepared directory
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - cf_local_root.stat.isdir | default(false)
    - not (cf_local_root.stat.islnk | default(false))
- name: Verify consumer identity
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - python3
    - -c
    - "import json, os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\npath, identity, mode = sys.argv[1:4]\n\
      if not str(Path(path).parent).startswith('/tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example-'):\n\
      \    raise SystemExit('unexpected root')\nif mode == 'install':\n    with open(path,\
      \ 'x') as out: out.write(identity)\nelse:\n    if Path(path).is_symlink() or\
      \ json.loads(Path(path).read_text()) != json.loads(identity):\n        raise\
      \ SystemExit('consumer marker identity differs')\n    if mode == 'rollback':\
      \ os.unlink(path)\n"
    - '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata | to_json }}'
    - verify
  changed_when: false

- name: Release only matching consumer marker
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - python3
    - -c
    - "import json, os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\npath, identity, mode = sys.argv[1:4]\n\
      if not str(Path(path).parent).startswith('/tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example-'):\n\
      \    raise SystemExit('unexpected root')\nif mode == 'install':\n    with open(path,\
      \ 'x') as out: out.write(identity)\nelse:\n    if Path(path).is_symlink() or\
      \ json.loads(Path(path).read_text()) != json.loads(identity):\n        raise\
      \ SystemExit('consumer marker identity differs')\n    if mode == 'rollback':\
      \ os.unlink(path)\n"
    - '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata | to_json }}'
    - rollback

- name: Verify consumer identity
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - python3
    - -c
    - "import json, os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\npath, identity, mode = sys.argv[1:4]\n\
      if not str(Path(path).parent).startswith('/tmp/clusterforge-foundation-example-'):\n\
      \    raise SystemExit('unexpected root')\nif mode == 'install':\n    with open(path,\
      \ 'x') as out: out.write(identity)\nelse:\n    if Path(path).is_symlink() or\
      \ json.loads(Path(path).read_text()) != json.loads(identity):\n        raise\
      \ SystemExit('consumer marker identity differs')\n    if mode == 'rollback':\
      \ os.unlink(path)\n"
    - '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    - '{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata | to_json }}'
    - verify
  changed_when: false

- name: Inspect consumer marker
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: '{{ cf.inputs.prepared_root }}/.clusterforge-consumer-example'
    follow: false
  register: cf_local_marker
- name: Require absent marker
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: not cf_local_marker.stat.exists
